thread:
mia: quick Q — where's the best place to save a logsearch for AP-SG embed route p95 latency >200ms + status 429/503? want ops to be able to reuse it and add to the embed routes dashboard. also need kv_cache hits=false (misses) filter. stub below.

```
route:embed AND region:ap-sg AND model:"redwood-3b-q" AND (status:429 OR status:503) | stats p95(latency) as p95_latency
```

sam: Use the shared 'ops-views' saved searches space in Logboard (we keep cross-org ones there). Query looks fine but wrap model list and include kv filter. I can save it. Global or org-scoped?

mia: global please. Also include redwood-7b-q as well (both quantized variants). Keep name short.

jordan: +1. Also add kv_cache.hit:false to focus on cold misses — that's what spiky latencies usually track.

sam: final query I used and will save as ops/embed-ap-sg-p95-kv-miss-429-503:

```
route:embed AND region:ap-sg AND model:("redwood-3b-q" OR "redwood-7b-q") AND status:(429 OR 503) AND kv_cache.hit:false | stats p95(latency) as p95_latency by org, host
```

sam: Saved: https://logs.redwood.io/saved/ops/embed-ap-sg-p95-kv-miss-429-503 (ops/embed-ap-sg-p95-kv-miss-429-503) :white_check_mark: I also added it to the dashboard 'Embed routes -> AP-SG' under the shared ops dashboard.

observability-bot: Saved search created by sam (id: saved_9f3b2). Visible to everyone in ops-views.

alex: I'll add a non-critical alert around p95 > 250ms for 5min (notify slack #incidents only if >5 hosts affected). Will submit PR for alert rule and add a runbook link.

mia: thanks — please @mia on the PR so I can review the runbook text.

sam: done, PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/482

jordan: quick note — if anyone needs a per-model split we can add model as a dashboard breakdown or saved view param.

mia: great, thanks all. saved search + alert flow covers my ask.
